policy: Exact hash/socket/category/currentlyCanRoll/real randomized pool. No enhanced, family-wide defaults, curated-only inference, or same-name Precision Frame promotion.
limitations: Exact source identity/socket eligibility is established only for the pinned official manifest, not all live or future weapon editions.
Pyroclastic Flow intrinsic tracking is automatic eligibility for this exact weapon hash; ADS target locking is still required. Automatic eligibility does not mean hip-fire auto-acquisition.
Tracking Module is optional selected base trait on two exact selected hashes. Source initialItemHash is not a local default-equipped claim.
All 63 selected hashes and all referenced randomized/reusable pools plus direct socket choices were scanned before deriving eligibility; no family exclusion or name-only inference.
Enhanced Tracking Module and other precision intrinsics, including same-name nonrocket items, are not supported by this profile.
Primary descriptions prove aimed/ADS locking but not acquire time, cone, range, turn rate, grace time, shot snapshot, continued ADS, reacquisition, or post-launch stow/trait-edit behavior.
Midflight LOS-loss cancellation is not proven. Ordinary projectile collision with a wall is distinct from cancelling guidance merely because the target becomes occluded.

A secondary light.gg community entry reports one second of aim-loss persistence and diminished PvP effectiveness, but no primary measurement protocol was inspected. These are reported evidence, not adopted exact numeric runtime rules.
One-second prelaunch aim grace must not be confused with a one-second lifetime or homing expiry for an already-fired rocket.
Any author-selected timing/cone/range/turning/ownership/LOS policies belong to separately labelled local Minecraft tuning, not source-exact D2 values.
No source found establishes equivalence of precision intrinsic and base Tracking Module quantitative guidance; do not claim identical measured tuning.
No native rendering, audio/listening, gameplay, multiplayer, or performance acceptance is performed by this source extractor.
